implementationDecisions: Five continuous exposed stair flights with switchback landings, stringers and handrails replace the detached fragment. Lower-deck landing meets the exposed white deck outside the opaque red shell; upper flights terminate at retained roof.
The existing positive-X attachment side is retained; exact northeast alignment, widths, turn positions and tread counts have not been verified against a photograph or survey.
Three shallow white XZ-plane strips form a flat H above the existing helipad, centred on the disc.
A roof perimeter railing gap permits entry from the final landing.

A narrow raised steel approach bridge at the existing initial-landing height runs through the undercroft and turns onto the first landing without crossing its handrails. This removes the disconnected 1 m bottom barrier without inventing stairs into the water. The source supports the raised bridge arrangement, while 1 m local datum, native-edge endpoint and local routing remain approximate; shore/terrain connection outside the footprint remains unverified.
The dedicated builder is scripts/landmarks/rem-eiland-builder.ts exporting buildRemEiland(w,d,b). Cultural builder extraction leaves other landmarks untouched.
